title: Anthropic · 更新日志来源更新
summary: Anthropic 更新 ant CLI 版本说明，将 beta:sessions connect 功能从“新增”改为正式版本描述，功能本身未变，但版本号明确为 1.32.0。

added_lines: Version 1.32.0 of the ant CLI adds ant beta:sessions connect, which attaches your terminal to a Claude Managed Agents session. You can follow the session live, send messages, and allow or deny tool calls that are waiting for approval. Pass --web to serve the Claude Console's session viewer locally and open the session there instead. See Connect to a Managed Agents session from your terminal.
